---
title: "Roadmap"
---

Scope: SDTM, ADaM and TFL programs written in SAS should run with sasonr and
give the same results as SAS 9.4.

| Milestone | Content | Status |
|---|---|---|
| Front end | Lexer, Pratt expressions, faithful DATA step AST, macro processor | ✅ done |
| DATA step | L1/L2/L3 compilation to tidyverse, PDV rules, `_ERROR_`, INPUT/INFILE | ✅ core done; hash objects, `POINT=`, `UPDATE` open |
| Functions and formats | ~200 functions, ~80 formats/informats, PROC FORMAT | 🔄 function-by-function verification against SAS started |
| PROC SQL | Own parser + DuckDB, SAS semantics | ✅ done (dictionary tables open) |
| Data management PROCs | SORT, PRINT, TRANSPOSE, CONTENTS, DATASETS, APPEND, DELETE | ✅ done; COMPARE, IMPORT/EXPORT open |
| Descriptive statistics | MEANS/SUMMARY, FREQ | ✅ done; FREQ test statistics awaiting SAS verification; UNIVARIATE open |
| Reporting | PROC REPORT, TABULATE, ODS RTF/HTML | ⬜ next |
| Statistical PROCs | GLM, MIXED, LIFETEST, PHREG, LOGISTIC (via CRAN packages) | ⬜ planned |
| End-to-end acceptance | Book programs (Little SAS Book, pharmaceutical programming examples) | 🔄 SAS results ready, sasonr runs pending |

See [Conformance status](conformance.html) for the current numbers and [To do and future plan](todo.html) for the next steps.
